notes: User-provided solid masses; all listed printed parts except the solid hinge use a 0.15 mass factor.
Uniform volume density is assumed within each part or purchased assembly, not equal mass per STL file.
One servo mass covers its 11 motor_* mesh occurrences, including caps, horns and connectors.
Each MGN12C mass covers five mesh components; the model contains two complete blocks.
The 40 g actuator mass is shared by volume over its six mesh components on both rail links.
Unspecified parts retain visual/collision geometry but contribute no assigned mass.
No automatic normalization to a hypothetical whole-hand mass is performed.
